Kpler data showed Hormuz crude exports at about 8.5M bpd (40% below prewar), and Secretary of State Rubio claimed exports were near prewar levels via pipeline workarounds.
key_facts: US sanctioned 17 Iran shadow fleet vessels
Kpler: Hormuz crude 8.5M bpd, 40% below direct prewar
Rubio: total ME exports near prewar via pipeline routes
Iranian tanker attacks escalating in early October
US naval blockade of Iranian ports in place

headline: Micron rose in early October after SK Hynix said it was sold out of all 2026 production
summary: Micron Technology shares rose in early October 2026 after rival SK Hynix disclosed it had sold out its entire 2026 production capacity, a bullish signal for memory market supply-demand balance. The positive news preceded the CXMT-driven selloff that hit memory names in the October 12-13 period.
key_facts: SK Hynix sold out all 2026 production capacity
Micron rose on SK Hynix sold-out announcement
Positive signal for memory supply-demand balance
Preceded the Oct 12-13 CXMT-driven selloff
HBM (AI memory) demand driving SK Hynix production sell-through

headline: Broadcom's $60B debt deal ties its fortunes to Anthropic IPO
summary: Broadcom took on $60 billion in debt financing tied to its Anthropic exposure, raising the stakes heading into Anthropic's expected November 2026 IPO. The deal underscores the massive institutional bet being placed on AI companies ahead of what could be the largest technology IPO in history.
key_facts: Broadcom $60B debt deal tied to Anthropic IPO exposure
Anthropic targeting $2T valuation in November IPO
Deal raises stakes for Broadcom AVGO shareholders
Largest tech IPO in history if $2T target achieved

headline: TSMC Q3 2026 earnings preview: AI boom accelerates, analysts bullish on revenue beat
summary: Analysts are broadly bullish ahead of TSMC's October 15 Q3 2026 earnings, given that published monthly revenue data already confirms a record quarter of $46.7B (+50% YoY). The focus is on gross margin guidance, 2nm ramp trajectory, and the 2027 capex outlook as major AI chip customers continue to invest heavily.
key_facts: TSMC Q3 revenue already reported: $46.7B (+50% YoY) record
Beat own guidance of $44.6-45.8B
Gross margin guidance: 65-67%
2026 capex raised to $60-64B (from $52-56B)
Focus on 2027 AI demand outlook and 2nm ramp
Consensus ADR EPS ~$4.41-4.43

headline: Can TSMC earnings save the AI trade amid chip selloff?
summary: With memory chip stocks under pressure from CXMT competition fears, markets are looking to TSMC's October 15 earnings as a potential catalyst for the semiconductor sector. Strong Q4 guidance from TSMC could reinvigorate confidence in AI chip demand, while weak guidance could extend the current selloff.
key_facts: TSMC Oct 15 earnings as potential catalyst for chip stocks
Memory stocks down 5th consecutive day before report
Strong Q4 guidance from TSMC could reverse selloff
2nm ramp and CoWoS advanced packaging in focus
AI chip customers (NVDA, AAPL, AMD) demand trajectory key

headline: Goldman Sachs Q3 2026 preview: FICC revenue cooling, expenses rising, consensus wide
summary: Goldman Sachs faces a high bar heading into Q3 2026 earnings after a record Q2 (EPS $20.98). Analysts project FICC (fixed income, currencies, commodities) trading revenue to cool seasonally, while expenses are rising. The wide consensus EPS range ($12.86-$15.39) reflects uncertainty about trading performance.
